title: Universal cohomology vanishing over a binary closed union
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian topological space (ascending chains of open subsets stabilize), let $Z,W$ be closed subsets and let $q\geq0$. Suppose $H^q(Z,G)=0$ for every abelian sheaf $G$ on $Z$ and $H^q(W,G)=0$ for every abelian sheaf $G$ on $W$, with the subspace topologies [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Then $H^q(Z\cup W,F)=0$ for every abelian sheaf $F$ on $Z\cup W$ with its subspace topology.

source.place: Proposition 02UZ (cohomology-proposition-vanishing-Noetherian), component-reduction paragraph; Lemma 02UV; Modules Lemma 02UT

proof.text: Put T=Z union W. The subspace T is Noetherian. The relative closed subsets Z and W have the same intrinsic topologies as the original subsets: both are induced by the inclusion into X. Let U=T minus Z; since Z is closed, U is open.

Apply [lem-sc-noetherian-open-closed-cohomology-sequence] on T. The right term is the pushforward of the inverse image of F on Z. The left term is a closed pushforward of a sheaf G from C=closure_T(U).

U is contained in W and W is closed, so C is contained in W. Push G forward along C into W. Closed-pushforward comparison [lem-sc-cohomology-closed-immersion-pushforward] and the hypothesis on all sheaves on W kill H^q(C,G). The same comparison and the hypothesis on Z kill the right term. The support comparison in the preceding step kills the left term. The intrinsic subspace topology identifications induce equivalences of the opens sites, so the hypotheses apply to these exact sheaves.

Use the natural long exact sequence for sheaf cohomology recorded in [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Exactness between zero outer degree-q groups makes the middle group zero. For q=0 this is the initial left-exact segment. This uses no degree-(q-1) intersection hypothesis.

lean.statement:
theorem cohomology_vanishing_of_closed_union
    (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] [NoetherianSpace X]
    (Z W : Closeds X) (q : ℕ)
    (hZ : ∀ G : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (Z : Set X)) AddCommGrpCat.{u},
      IsZero (Sheaf.H' G q (⊤ : Opens (Z : Set X))))
    (hW : ∀ G : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (W : Set X)) AddCommGrpCat.{u},
      IsZero (Sheaf.H' G q (⊤ : Opens (W : Set X))))
    (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Z ⊔ W : Closeds X) : Set X))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    IsZero (Sheaf.H' F q (⊤ : Opens ((Z ⊔ W : Closeds X) : Set X)))
